remarks: Charming East Norwalk Home with Pool & Prime Location! Nestled in the heart of a sought-after water community, this spacious East Norwalk rental offers an unbeatable lifestyle with walking distance to Calf Pasture and Shady Beach,Taylor Farm Dog Park, and Norwalk Cove Marina. Perfect for those seeking coastal living with modern amenities! Commuters dream with close proximity to both South and East Norwalk Metro-North Train Stations as well as 1-95 and the Merritt Parkway. This 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath features an in-ground pool and fenced-in landscaped backyard. Enjoy your mornings in the enclosed three-season front porch or entertain in the expansive living room. The spacious eat-in kitchen is a chef's dream with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and sliding glass doors that open to your backyard retreat. The main floor includes a large bedroom and renovated bathroom. Upstairs, the primary bedroom boasts a skylight and walk-in closets, plus two additional large bedrooms with their own walk-in closets. The luxuriously renovated bathroom offers a jacuzzi tub, tiled shower, and another skylight for a spa-like experience. Bonus features include a finished lower level with a family/game room, wet bar, half bath, and laundry area. Plenty of storage available in the attic. Minutes away from SONO and Downtown Westport this home provides both convenience and comfort. Don't miss the chance to live in this stunning East Norwalk retreat!
